title: kithctl watch: sender always shows (unknown) in notifications
description: watch.rs fetch_and_notify requests properties:["sender","body"] and then reads msg.get("sender"). The wire field is "senderId" not "sender"; Message/get ignores the properties filter and returns all fields anyway. msg.get("sender") always returns None → sender is hardcoded to "(unknown)" in every desktop notification. Trigger: any received message on Linux/macOS. Bad behavior: notification shows "Kith: (unknown): <body>" instead of the contact's login name or display name.
